items.label: 03 — THE MUSIC

items.q: How do I access the audios after signing up?
items.a: As soon as your subscription is confirmed, you get immediate access to the full library. Simply log in at spotszen.fr from your browser — no app to download.

items.q: Is the audio quality truly professional?
items.a: Absolutely. Each immersion is recorded in a professional studio, with warm human voices and original music composed specifically with binaural frequencies.

items.q: Are there audios suitable for children?
items.a: Yes. Several immersions are designed for children aged 4-12: short, soothing sessions with a gentle voice suited to their world.

items.q: How do I cancel my subscription?
items.a: You can cancel at any time from your personal space on spotszen.fr. No notice period, no penalty. Your access remains active until the end of the current period.

Your students connect with their institutional email, from their phone, at any time — the night before an exam, after a busy day, or before sleep.

sante.sub: Clinics · Hospitals · Rehabilitation centres · Maternity units · Medical wellness centres
sante.title: Non-pharmaceutical support, accessible from the room.
sante.body: Pre-operative anxiety affects between 60 and 80% of patients. Sleep quality in healthcare settings is systematically impaired by the environment, lighting and stress. Spots Zen offers a complementary audio tool — guided meditations, breathing exercises, deep relaxation techniques — accessible from the room via QR code.
sante.formTitle: Let's talk about your care project
sante.legal: Spots Zen is a complementary wellness tool. It is not a medical device and does not replace any care protocol.

collectivites.title: Turn your public spaces into places of renewal.
collectivites.body: The wellbeing of residents and visitors is a quality-of-life and territorial attractiveness issue. Spots Zen allows local authorities to create rest spaces in their public areas — a bench facing the sea, a corner of a park, a viewpoint, a library room — and offer free, immediate audio support. A discreet sign. A QR code. A guiding voice.
